statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ has completed a full two-way round trip of its 30,372.25-30,717.75 session range and trades 30,664.75, roughly 53 points below the high, while the Nasdaq-100 cash index opened up 0.45%. Implied volatility is decaying, the ten-year is steady and crude is 2.4% lower, so the cross-asset stack does not confirm a pathological one-way path.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold, so the mapped state is WATCH for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. A narrow elevated-risk window is flagged from 14:00 to 15:00 UTC, covering the August JOLTS and September CB Consumer Confidence releases that print 30 minutes into the cash session alongside the 14:30 UTC Dallas Fed services index; the published forecast maps that single hour to BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Outside it the forecast returns to the watch band and reaches the low band through the US afternoon and overnight hours. The next comparable checkpoint is the 12:15 to 12:30 UTC ADP and August core PCE block on September 30, the final hour of this forecast, which is also mapped to the elevated band. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by this mapping.
headline: NQ holds 30,664.75, up 0.32%, after retracing the full 30,372.25-30,717.75 range as VIX eases to 15.83, the 10-year steadies at 5.23% and WTI falls 2.4% to 90.41 into the JOLTS cluster
body: NQ front-month trades 30,664.75, up 98.50 points or 0.32% against a 30,566.25 prior close, on a quote timestamped 13:18 UTC. The session opened at 30,560.50, fell to 30,372.25, recovered roughly 345 points to a 30,717.75 high, and has since given back about 53 points. Both extremes of the range have been visited and each leg has drawn a meaningful retracement, which is the structure in which mean reversion works rather than fails. The Nasdaq-100 cash index opened at 30,412.29 and trades 30,412.86, up 0.45% against a 30,276.81 close, so the opening auction printed without a gap dislocation. Implied volatility is decaying: VIX is 15.83, down 1.49% from a 16.07 close, inside a 15.73 to 16.19 range. The duration picture has stabilised after Monday's selloff, when the ten-year closed at 5.234%, its highest since June 2007, the thirty-year reached 5.552%, the highest since 2004, and the two-year printed 5.163%; the ten-year now trades 5.23%, one basis point lower, in a narrow 5.21 to 5.24 band. Crude is the clearest improvement, with WTI down 2.36% to 90.41 and Brent down 1.97% to 103.21 as the United States and Iran engage mediators, easing the inflation impulse that drove Monday's repricing. Semiconductors, the source of Monday's damage when Arm fell 8.7% and the Nasdaq Composite lost 0.9% to 26,820.38, are rebounding: SOXX added 0.83% pre-market, Micron rose about 1.5%, Nvidia gained roughly 0.8% after authorising a further 150 billion dollars of buybacks, and AMD rose about 1% on an 8.2 billion dollar all-stock acquisition. Against that, OpenAI has paused frontier-model training after its new model failed internal safety testing, a genuine AI-complex headwind that hit Marvell and Sandisk on Monday. The net picture is elevated but decaying Stress with no observed persistent one-way structure, which keeps Tail at the watch-band floor. The shared Finviz context file was not used as evidence for this assessment: it was collected at 07:33 UTC, roughly six hours old and therefore outside the 90-minute freshness limit, and its collection status was partial with the futures and calendar sections unavailable. All price, yield, volatility and calendar evidence above comes from independent current research.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding hours were published. Tail ranged from 17 to 27. Exactly one single-hour excursion reached the elevated band, at 14:00 UTC on Monday, and it reverted within the following hour. Tail troughed at 17 through the late Monday and early Tuesday overnight session, printed 24 at 01:00, 03:00 and 04:00 UTC around the European handover, then held 20 to 21 in each of the last seven hours. Stress fell steadily from 84 to 75 across the window as implied volatility decayed and the duration selloff stabilised. Confidence held between 86 and 88 throughout. The dominant mode was mixed for 14 of the 24 hours, trend-down for five around the overnight duration stress, normal for four in the quiet US evening, and trend-up for one hour as NQ pressed its session high.
outlookSummary: The published forecast keeps Tail in the watch band through the US cash session, with one elevated-band hour at 14:00 UTC where August JOLTS and September CB Consumer Confidence print 30 minutes into the session alongside the 14:30 UTC Dallas Fed services index. Tail then eases to the low band through the US afternoon and the overnight window, mirroring the pattern the lookback recorded a day earlier, before returning to the watch band across the European handover and cash session on September 30. The forecast closes with a second elevated-band hour at 12:00 UTC on September 30, covering the 12:15 UTC ADP employment change and the 12:30 UTC block of August core PCE, personal spending, final Q2 GDP and the advance goods trade balance. Stress is forecast to decay from 78 in the data hour to 69 overnight before rebuilding to 79 into the core PCE block, and Confidence steps down from 87 to 77 across the horizon as the current price-path evidence ages. Every hour beyond the current clock hour describes a conditional path rather than observed structure.
